environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. ALB has a single listener on port 443 with a default action forwarding to the target group. No additional listener rules or rule conditions are configured. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The service is publicly accessible via the ALB DNS name. Container runs as root with FLASK_DEBUG=0.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS:443 listener, default forward action only
